headline: Bitcoin is holding near $60,000 early Monday Bangkok time after Saturday's crash to a two-year low, with the crypto Fear & Greed Index at extreme fear and a heavy US holiday week of inflation data and a big options expiry ahead.

market.asOf: BTC from a Coin-Turk report timestamped 18:33 UTC Sun 22 Nov (01:33 Bangkok Mon). Fresh ETH and SOL snapshots could not be confirmed this run. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100, "Extreme Fear", on the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index (the page shows no update time).

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $60,000 after its crash to a two-year low
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $55,130 on Saturday, its lowest since September 2024, then bounced about 9%. By Sunday evening it was around $60,700. Forced selling has eased, but the mood is still extreme fear, and the US stock market open on Monday is the next test.
points: Bitcoin was about $60,687 on Sunday evening, up 1.98% in 24 hours and about 25.5% below a month ago, per Coin-Turk.
CoinDesk reported about $1.8 billion of liquidations (forced closing of borrowed bets) in 24 hours, $1.3 billion of them bets on higher prices, citing CoinGlass.
Holders locked in about $11.3 billion of losses over 7 days, per CryptoQuant data reported by CoinDesk.
The alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 11 out of 100, "Extreme Fear".

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low

stories.title: Fund outflows and a crowded holiday week keep pressure on crypto
stories.summary: Money kept leaving US bitcoin funds last week. This short Thanksgiving week brings US inflation data on Wednesday, with traders widely expecting the Fed to raise rates in December, and a large monthly bitcoin options expiry on Friday.
points: About $1.25 billion left US spot bitcoin ETFs in the week to 20 Nov, including a record $541.1 million outflow from BlackRock's IBIT on 19 Nov, per CEO Economy using Farside data.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had lost about $3.47 billion in November through 19 Nov, per The Block.
October PCE inflation and an updated estimate of Q3 GDP come out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET; core PCE is expected around 3.2% a year against 3.1% before, per FXIFY.
CME FedWatch showed about a 92% chance of a quarter-point December rate hike, per 24/7 Wall St (published 21 Nov); FXIFY put it at roughly 95%.
About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire on Deribit on Fri 27 Nov at 08:00 UTC, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov; Coinotag put it at about $6.6 billion.

The Block: November ETF outflows near $3.5 billion

stories.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy bitcoin buy as its paper loss deepens
stories.summary: Strategy, the company that holds 850,849 bitcoin, may announce another purchase: chairman Michael Saylor posted "The dots aren't done", a hint he has used before purchases, but nothing is confirmed until the company files. At current prices its bitcoin is worth well below what it paid, and it leaves the MSCI indexes at the end of the month.
points: Strategy holds 850,849 BTC bought at an average of $75,452, about $64.2 billion in total, per Coin-Turk.
At about $60,687 that stack is worth about $51.6 billion, an unrealized loss of about $12.56 billion, per Coin-Turk.
Its last purchase was 485 BTC for about $33.4 million over 9-15 Nov, per Coin-Turk.
Strategy is removed from MSCI indexes at the close on 30 Nov; index funds held about 13 million shares, worth about $1.59 billion, per Cryptonews.

sources.label: Coin-Turk: Saylor hints at another Strategy purchase

briefs.title: Chainflip hack losses about $12 million; bounty deadline Monday
briefs.summary: The loss includes 122.86 BTC, 520.22 ETH, 3.25 million USDC and 758,141 USDT; Chainflip offers the attacker 10% if 90% comes back by 1:38pm ET (18:38 UTC) on Mon 23 Nov, and the FLIP token fell about 37%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Kalshi faces a Monday court hearing in New York
briefs.summary: A New York court hears the state Attorney General's bid for a restraining order against Kalshi on Mon 23 Nov at 11:30am ET; Kalshi warns it could force a nationwide shutdown, per Bitcoin.com News.

briefs.title: Monad's first big team and investor unlock is Tuesday
briefs.summary: About 16.6 billion MON unlocks on Tue 24 Nov at the one-year cliff for team and investor tokens, per Coinranking. See the unlock table on this page for size and confidence.

briefs.title: CYBER investigates a suspected $1 million bridge exploit
briefs.summary: South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb froze CYBER deposits and withdrawals while the project investigates, per The Block.

briefs.title: SEC charges fake crypto exchange scheme
briefs.summary: The SEC alleges eight Colorado-based entities running fake crypto trading platforms and advisers took at least $37 million from more than 1,500 US investors, per Altcoin Buzz.

briefs.title: ARK withdraws two planned crypto index ETFs
briefs.summary: ARK filed on 20 Nov to withdraw its CoinDesk 20 and CoinDesk 20 ex-Bitcoin crypto ETF registrations, with no reason given, per Altcoin Buzz.

briefs.title: Ripple and Mastercard plan card settlement in RLUSD
briefs.summary: Ripple, Mastercard, Gemini and WebBank plan to settle card transactions in the RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger, pending regulatory approval, per Altcoin Buzz.

calendar.note: SOON on Monday 23, MON (the largest, about 16.6 billion tokens worth about $220M on this desk's data) and SOSO on Tuesday 24, XPL and H on Wednesday 25, HUMA on Thursday 26, SIGN, PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28, and FF and CARDS on Sunday 29 November. See the unlock table on this page for sizes, dates and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
Manufacturing is expected at 54.5 (October: 54.9) and services at 55.6 (October: 56.1), per FXEmpire.

calendar.event: New York court hearing on Kalshi
calendar.note: A New York court hears the Attorney General's request for a restraining order against Kalshi; Kalshi warns it could force a nationwide shutdown, per Bitcoin.com News.

calendar.event: New York Fed President John Williams speaks
calendar.note: Remarks on the economic outlook and monetary policy, followed by Q&A, per the New York Fed.
Expected at 92.1 after 91.7 in October, per FXEmpire.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (updated estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: Core PCE is expected around 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), per FXIFY. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% after 3.4% before, durable goods at 0.5% after 1.9%, and weekly jobless claims at 201K after 203K, per FXEmpire.
Out at 2:00pm ET, per the Fed's November calendar. New home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok); 649K is expected after 676K, per FXEmpire.
US stock and bond markets are closed, and on Friday 27 Nov stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per FXIFY. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.

calendar.event: Monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire, with the "max pain" level at $73,000, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov; Coinotag put it at about $6.6 billion on 22 Nov.

calendar.event: Strategy (MSTR) leaves MSCI indexes at the close
calendar.note: Removal takes effect at the 30 Nov market close; index funds held about 13 million Strategy shares, worth about $1.59 billion, per Cryptonews.
Comes out before the Fed's 9 Dec decision. November CPI is Thu 10 Dec, the day after the Fed decision, per the BLS schedule.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Two-day meeting 8-9 Dec, per the Fed's calendar. Fed officials stop public comment on policy from Sat 28 Nov, per FXIFY. CME FedWatch showed about a 92% chance of a quarter-point hike, per 24/7 Wall St (published 21 Nov); FXIFY put it at roughly 95%.
